pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: board-status: Only store CBMEM console from last boot Since CBMEM console became a ring buffer, logs from several boots can be stored. We are only interested in the current boot. > -c | --console: print cbmem console > -1 | --oneboot: print cbmem console for last boot only For CBMEM time stamps only the time stamps of the current boot are stored, so only the commands for the CBMEM console need to be adapted. gooftool: add model name into the report name of GRT. In the past, one umpire instance is to support one project / overlay. But now, one umpire is to support one uni-build project which might introduce multiple models. As a result, it is hard to identify which model is this report for.
